name: Funahashi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Funahashi village emblem in yellow and maroon: a yellow disc bearing a maroon stylised device of pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Funahashi, a village in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 June 1973.

features.role: Funahashi village emblem — a yellow disc bearing a maroon stylised device of pointed strokes
